AdaptiveSweepSpec.description:
Adaptive frequency sweep (issue #708): a Galerkin projection
reduced-order model with greedy snapshot sampling
([`geode_core::driven::rom`]; Palace's adaptive fast sweep).

A few **snapshot** frequencies get a full-order direct solve (one LU
factorization each, one back-solve per port); every other frequency
is **interpolated** through a small dense reduced system. The greedy
loop adds the frequency with the worst residual indicator
`η(ω) = ‖A(ω)·x_rom − b(ω)‖ / ‖b(ω)‖` (the true full-order relative
residual of the reduced solution, worst over the port excitations)
until `η ≤ tolerance` everywhere or `max_snapshots` is spent. Any
frequency still above `tolerance` then gets a full-order fallback
solve, so every reported point is either a full-order solve or
certified at `η ≤ tolerance`.

Needs `solver.mode = "direct"` and lumped `ports`; rejected with
`absorbing_regions` (the matched UPML is re-assembled per frequency)
and with `wave_ports`. Leontovich and Silver-Müller walls are
supported.

tolerance.description:
Residual-indicator tolerance `η` (default `1e-6`; in `(0, 1)`). A
bound on the relative **residual**, not on the error in `Z` / `S`:
the error can exceed it by the conditioning of `A(ω)` (see
`crates/geode-cli/README.md` for measured ratios).

AdaptiveSweepStats.description:
Diagnostics of an adaptive (reduced-order-model) sweep (additive in
v1, issue #708). Each frequency is either **solved** (a full-order
direct solve: a greedy snapshot or a fallback) or **interpolated**
(evaluated through the reduced model, certified at residual indicator
`≤ tolerance`); `results[].solved` says which.

converged.description:
Whether the greedy loop reached `tolerance` over every frequency
within the budget. When `false`, the frequencies still above it
were solved full-order (`fallback_frequencies_hz`).

fallback_frequencies_hz.description:
Frequencies (Hz) above `tolerance` after the greedy loop, solved
full-order instead (ascending; empty when `converged`).

n_factorizations.description:
Sparse LU factorizations spent (snapshots + fallbacks); a dense
sweep spends one per frequency.

n_interpolated.description: Requested frequencies evaluated through the reduced model.

n_solved.description:
Requested frequencies with a full-order solve (snapshots and
fallbacks).

reduced_order.description: Dimension of the reduced model (`≤ n_snapshots × n_ports`).

snapshot_frequencies_hz.description:
Greedy snapshot frequencies (Hz), in selection order (the three
seeds — band ends and midpoint — first).

worst_residual.description:
Worst residual indicator over the frequency grid when the greedy
loop stopped (before any fallback solve).

BoundaryConditionsSpec.description:
Boundary conditions: PEC, Leontovich and (additive in v1, issue
#683) first-order Silver-Müller absorbing walls. A dimension-2
physical group may carry at most one of {port, wave port, PEC,
Leontovich, Silver-Müller}.

pec.description:
Dimension-2 physical-group names whose edges are eliminated as
perfect electric conductor (tangential `E = 0`).

silver_muller.description:
Dimension-2 physical-group names carrying the first-order
Silver-Müller absorbing (radiation) condition — the impedance
boundary with `Z_s = η₀` (no parameters). Driven / extract specs
only.

CapacitanceReport.description:
`geode capacitance` report (`kind = "capacitance"`, additive in v1).

All capacitances are real, in farads (SI: the mesh length unit is
folded in), row-major `c_farad[row][col]` in terminal order.

c_farad.description:
The N×N Maxwell capacitance matrix (F): diagonal `> 0`,
off-diagonals `≤ 0` (mutual capacitance is `−c_farad[i][j]`).

c_flux_diag_farad.description:
Independent surface-flux cross-check of the diagonal (F), `Q_i =
∮ ε(−∇φ⁽ⁱ⁾)·n̂ dS` over the terminal's triangles with a piecewise-
constant field: a looser sanity signal (a few–15 % on curved
surfaces), not the result. `null` for a terminal whose surface is
not entirely on the mesh boundary (e.g. a zero-thickness sheet
with dielectric on both sides), where the one-sided flux would be
wrong.

c_sigma_farad.description:
Per terminal, the row sum `Σ_j C_ij` (F): the capacitance from
that terminal to ground with every other terminal also grounded.

capacitance.description: The capacitance settings and system size.

git_sha.description: Git revision baked in at build time (`<sha>[-dirty]` or `unknown`).

max_rel_asymmetry.description:
`max |C_ij − C_ji| / max(|C_ij|, |C_ji|)`. Structural only: the
energy method fills `C_ji` from `C_ij`, so this is `0` unless the
matrix is corrupted — it is not a solver residual.

maxwell_sign_structure.description:
Maxwell sign structure (positive diagonal, non-positive
off-diagonals and non-negative row sums, to `1e-9` relative).
`false` flags a mesh that violates the discrete maximum principle
(e.g. badly obtuse tets) — inspect the matrix; it is not an error.

mesh.description:
Mesh summary (`n_edges` / `n_interior` are the H(curl) counts of
the other analyses, unused here; the scalar system size is in
`capacitance`).

regions.description: Volume regions with applied permittivities (`eps_r[1]` is `0`).

sensitivities.description:
`∂C/∂ε_r` of the two-terminal capacitance (additive in v1, issue
#707; present only with a spec `sensitivity` section). The
observable (named `"c_farad_p2"`) is the **P2** two-terminal
capacitance (the library's capacitance adjoint), reported as each
entry's `value` — it differs from the P1 `c_farad[0][0]` by the P1
discretization error.

spec_path.description: Spec path as given on the command line.

spice_file.description:
The SPICE subcircuit `.subckt` written by `--spice` (additive in
v1; present only with that flag).

terminals.description:
Terminal names in matrix row/column order (same order as
`capacitance.terminals`).

threads.description: `--threads` value, or `null` when not given (library defaults).

CapacitanceSettingsSummary.description:
Echo of a resolved `capacitance` spec section plus the size of the
scalar electrostatic system (additive in v1).

conductor_model.description:
Always `"non_driven_grounded"`: in the excitation of terminal *i*
(1 V) every other terminal and every ground surface is held at
0 V. There is no floating (charge-neutral) conductor model.

element.description: Always `"p1_tet"` (nodal linear Lagrange on the tets).

n_dof.description: Scalar DOFs before Dirichlet elimination (= mesh nodes).

n_free_dof.description:
Free DOFs after pinning every terminal and ground node (the size
of the SPD system factored per excitation).

n_solves.description:
Unit-voltage solves (one per terminal), each a sparse LU
factorization + solve.

nnz_k.description:
Non-zeros of the full scalar stiffness pattern
(`n_nodes + 2·n_edges`).

inner.description: Always `"direct_lu"` (faer sparse LU, real SPD system).

method.description: Always `"energy"`: `C_ij = φ⁽ⁱ⁾ᵀ K φ⁽ʲ⁾` with the full stiffness.

wall_time_s.description: Wall time of assembly + every solve + post-processing, seconds.

CapacitanceSpec.description:
Static capacitance-extraction settings (`geode capacitance`, issue
#705).

Solves the scalar electrostatic problem `−∇·(ε₀ε_r ∇φ) = 0` on the
tets (P1, per-region real `ε_r` from `materials`) once per terminal:
terminal *i* held at 1 V, **every other terminal and every ground
surface held at 0 V**. The Maxwell capacitance matrix follows from the
energy method `C_ij = φ⁽ⁱ⁾ᵀ K φ⁽ʲ⁾`
([`geode_core::assembly::electrostatic::extract_capacitance`]).

**Conductor model.** Every conductor is voltage-driven: a non-excited
terminal is *grounded* (0 V), never floating. There is no
charge-neutral floating-conductor formulation; a metal body with no
electrical connection must still be listed as a terminal (its
row/column is then part of the Maxwell matrix, from which floating
behaviour can be derived by circuit reduction). Surfaces not listed
anywhere are natural boundaries (zero normal `D`, i.e. a symmetry /
open-circuit wall), not conductors.

ground.description:
Dimension-2 physical-group names pinned to 0 V in every
excitation: the reference / return conductor(s) — ground plane,
shield, enclosure. At least one is required in v1.

terminals.description:
Dimension-2 physical-group names, one per conductor terminal, in
matrix row/column order (`≥ 1`, distinct).

analysis.description:
`"driven"`, `"eigen"`, `"extract"` or `"capacitance"` — the
analysis the spec describes (additive in v1).

capacitance.description:
The resolved `capacitance` section with its scalar DOF counts,
`null` unless a capacitance spec (additive in v1).

eigen.description:
The resolved `eigen` section, `null` unless an eigen spec
(additive in v1).

extract.description:
The resolved `extract` section, `null` unless an extract spec
(additive in v1).

git_sha.description: Git revision baked in at build time (`<sha>[-dirty]` or `unknown`).

inductance.description:
The resolved `inductance` section with its edge-DOF counts, `null`
unless an inductance spec (additive in v1, issue #714).

resources.description:
Up-front memory / cost estimate for the solve (additive in v1;
order-of-magnitude only — see [`ResourceEstimate`]). `null` for a
capacitance spec: the estimate is calibrated on the complex / real
Nédélec H(curl) pencil and has no measured basis for the scalar
electrostatic system (whose size is in `capacitance`).

spec_path.description: Spec path as given on the command line.

threads.description: `--threads` value, or `null` when not given (library defaults).

wave_ports.description: Wave ports (additive in v1; `modes` is `null` — no modal solve).

ConductorSummary.description: One conductor of a capacitance spec (terminal or ground surface).

n_nodes.description: Distinct mesh nodes pinned to this conductor's potential.

CurrentPathSpec.description: One open current path of an [`InductanceSpec`].

conductor.description:
Dimension-3 physical group: the conductor volume the current flows
through (homogeneous: the current distribution of a single-material
path does not depend on its conductivity).

name.description: Path name (the inductance matrix row/column label).

sink.description:
Dimension-2 physical group on the conductor's boundary where the
current leaves (distinct from, and node-disjoint with, `source`).

source.description:
Dimension-2 physical group on the conductor's boundary where the
current enters.

CurrentPathSummary.description: One current path of an inductance spec.

DispersionSpec.description:
Frequency-dependent relative-permittivity model of a material
(issue #757), selected by `model`. Further models are added as new
`model` variants.

oneOf.description:
Djordjevic–Sarkar wideband Debye model (Djordjević et al., IEEE
Trans. EMC 43(4), 2001): `ε_r(f) = ε∞ + Δε/L · log₁₀((f₂ + jf) /
(f₁ + jf))` with `L = log₁₀(f₂/f₁)`, fitted so that
`ε_r(f_ref) = eps_r·(1 − j·tan_delta)` exactly — a nearly flat
loss tangent and a slowly falling `ε′` across `[f₁, f₂]` (FR-4 and
laminate datasheets).

f_high_hz.description: Upper corner `f₂` (Hz) of the model band (default `1e12`).

f_low_hz.description: Lower corner `f₁` (Hz) of the model band (default `1e3`).

f_ref_hz.description:
Frequency (Hz) at which `eps_r` / `tan_delta` are given
(required; `f_low_hz < f_ref_hz < f_high_hz`).

DispersionSummary.description:
A dispersive region's model: the inputs as given, the fitted
parameters and `ε_r(f)` at every requested frequency (additive in v1,
issue #757).

eps_r_at_frequencies.description:
`ε_r(f)` `[re, im]` at each entry of the report's `frequencies`, in
the same order (empty for a spec without frequencies).

absorbing_regions.description: Matched box-UPML shells (additive in v1; present only when used).

git_sha.description: Git revision baked in at build time (`<sha>[-dirty]` or `unknown`).

sensitivities.description:
`∂|S11|²/∂ε_r` of the single lumped port at every swept frequency
(additive in v1, issue #739; present only with a spec `sensitivity`
section). Observable `"s11_mag_sq"`; one entry per (parameter,
frequency), `index = [i]` into `results`.

silver_muller.description: Silver-Müller walls (additive in v1; present only when used).

spec_path.description: Spec path as given on the command line.

threads.description: `--threads` value, or `null` when not given (library defaults).

touchstone_file.description:
The Touchstone 2.0 `.sNp` written by `--touchstone` (additive in
v1; present only with that flag).

wave_ports.description:
Wave ports with their solved modes (additive in v1; present only
for wave-port specs).

absorbing_regions.description:
Matched box-UPML shells (`absorbing_regions`), frozen at
`solver.upml_reference_k0` (additive in v1, issue #706; omitted
when there are none).

git_sha.description: Git revision baked in at build time (`<sha>[-dirty]` or `unknown`).

sensitivities.description:
`∂f/∂ε_r` of the `sensitivity.modes` resonant frequencies (additive
in v1, issue #707; present only with a spec `sensitivity` section,
lossless pencil only).

spec_path.description: Spec path as given on the command line.

threads.description: `--threads` value, or `null` when not given (library defaults).

EigenSettingsSummary.description: Echo of a resolved `eigen` spec section.

sigma.description: Lanczos shift `σ = k₀²` ((rad / mesh length unit)²).

inner.description: Inner solve of `K − σM`: always `"direct_lu"` (sparse LU, factored once).

n_null_filtered.description: Ritz values dropped as the curl-curl gradient nullspace (`λ ≈ 0`).

n_overdamped_filtered.description:
Complex pencil only (additive in v1, issue #706): non-null Ritz
values dropped as **overdamped** — `Re(λ) ≤ 0`, i.e. `Q ≤ ½`, not a
resonance (absorber-trapped / evanescent quasi-modes of a UPML
pencil). Omitted for a lossless pencil.

pencil.description:
The pencil that was solved (additive in v1, issue #706):
`"real_symmetric"` (lossless: real `ε_r`, PEC walls) or
`"complex_symmetric"` (lossy `ε_r` and / or `absorbing_regions`;
complex eigenvalues, finite `Q`).

residual_rel_max.description: Largest relative eigen-residual over the returned modes.

upml_reference_k0.description:
Natural `k₀` (rad / mesh length unit) at which the
`absorbing_regions` UPML stretch was evaluated — the shift
`eigen.shift` (additive in v1; present only with
`absorbing_regions`). The UPML is frozen at this one frequency, so
the pencil stays linear; modes far from it see a mistuned absorber
(no self-consistent iteration).

wall_time_s.description: Wall time of assembly + eigensolve, seconds.

EigenSpec.description:
Eigenmode analysis settings (`geode eigen`).

Solves the PEC-cavity pencil `K x = k₀² M_ε x` with the pure-Rust
sparse shift-invert Lanczos (direct sparse-LU inner solve) and returns
the `n_modes` physical modes closest to `shift`, ascending. The pencil
is real symmetric (lossless, `Q = null`) for real `ε_r`, and complex
symmetric (complex `k₀`, finite `Q`) when any `materials[].eps_r` has
`Im < 0` or the spec has `absorbing_regions` (UPML frozen at `shift`;
issue #706). Leontovich / Silver-Müller walls are rejected: their
frequency-dependent terms would make the eigenproblem nonlinear.
`shift` must be `> 0`; place it just **below** the lowest mode of
interest (open cavities: **near** the resonance of interest) — the
curl-curl gradient nullspace sits at `k₀ = 0` and is filtered out, so a
shift near 0 wastes the Lanczos basis on it.

max_iters.description:
Lanczos basis size (default `160`). Raise it when modes are
nearly degenerate or when `n_modes` is large. Too small a basis
leaves modes unconverged: any returned mode whose relative
residual exceeds [`EigenSpec::residual_tol`] fails the run with
`solve_failed` (never silently wrong frequencies).

n_modes.description: Number of physical modes to return (`≥ 1`).

residual_tol.description:
Per-mode acceptance bound on the relative eigen-residual
`‖K x − λ M x‖ / (|λ| ‖M x‖)` (default `1e-6`). A mode above it is
unconverged and fails the run with `solve_failed`.

git_sha.description: Git revision baked in at build time (`<sha>[-dirty]` or `unknown`).

spec_path.description: Spec path as given on the command line.

threads.description: `--threads` value, or `null` when not given (library defaults).

absorbing_regions.description: Matched box-UPML shells (additive in v1; present only when used).

extraction.description: Per-port `L₀` / SRF extraction, in port order.

git_sha.description: Git revision baked in at build time (`<sha>[-dirty]` or `unknown`).

results.description:
Per-frequency results (as for `driven`), **ascending** in
frequency over the union of `frequencies` and the anchors.

silver_muller.description: Silver-Müller walls (additive in v1; present only when used).

spec_path.description: Spec path as given on the command line.

threads.description: `--threads` value, or `null` when not given (library defaults).

touchstone_file.description:
The Touchstone 2.0 `.sNp` written by `--touchstone` (additive in
v1; present only with that flag).

ExtractSettingsSummary.description: Echo of a resolved `extract` spec section.

anchor_frequencies.description:
The distinct anchor frequencies, ascending (the two lowest
extrapolate `L₀`, the third-lowest feeds the error estimate).

anchor_source.description:
`"frequencies"` or `"anchor_frequencies"` — the spec list the
`L₀` anchors were taken from.

l0_rel_tol.description:
Relative convergence gate on the `L₀` consistency estimate
(`null` = no gate).

ExtractSpec.description:
Inductance-extraction settings (`geode extract`).

The sweep itself is the driven one (`ports`, `frequencies`,
`boundary_conditions`, `solver`). On top of the per-frequency
`L = Im Z_kk / ω`, `R = Re Z_kk`, `Q = Im Z_kk / Re Z_kk`, `geode
extract` reports per port the quasi-static inductance
`L₀ = lim_{f→0} L(f)` by two-point Richardson extrapolation of
`L(f) ≈ L₀ − a·f²` on the two lowest **anchor** frequencies
([`geode_core::driven::extraction::extrapolate_l0`]), a consistency
error estimate from the third-lowest anchor, and the self-resonant
frequency (first `Im Z_kk` sign change) when the sweep brackets one.
Every field is optional: `"extract": {}` is a complete section.

anchor_frequencies.description:
Explicit `L₀` anchor ladder (`≥ 2` distinct points), solved **in
addition to** `frequencies` — e.g. a fine low-frequency ladder for
`L₀` next to a coarse sweep through the SRF. Omitted: the anchors
are the spec's `frequencies` (which then need `≥ 2` distinct
points). Either way the two lowest anchors extrapolate `L₀` and
the third-lowest (if any) feeds the error estimate.

l0_rel_tol.description:
Optional convergence gate on the extrapolation: fail the run
(`solve_failed`) if any port's relative consistency estimate
`|L₀(f₁,f₂) − L₀(f₂,f₃)| / |L₀|` exceeds it. Needs `≥ 3` anchors.
Omitted: no gate (the estimate is still reported).

FarFieldResult.description:
Near-to-far-field (NTFF) radiation quantities at one frequency
(additive in v1): Love surface equivalence over the closed box
`box_lo`–`box_hi` (the UPML inner wall shrunk 10 % toward its
centre), sampled on a 91 × 72 `(θ, φ)` grid (2° × 5°).

box_hi.description: NTFF / flux box high corner (mesh units).

box_lo.description: NTFF / flux box low corner (mesh units).

efficiency.description:
Radiation efficiency `η = P_rad / P_in`: box Poynting flux over
the net port input power `Σ_k ½ Re(V_k I_k*)` (`0` if
`P_in = 0`). Not clamped.

gain_broadside.description:
Broadside gain `G = D_broadside · η` (linear; `η` clamped to
`[0, 1]`).

FdCheckSpec.description:
Central finite-difference self-check settings of a
[`SensitivitySpec`].

The step is relative: parameter `p` is re-solved at `p ± h`, `h =
relative_step · |p|`. The defaults (`relative_step = 1e-4`, `tolerance
= 1e-4`) mirror the library's own adjoint-vs-FD validation tests
(`adjoint.rs` capacitance, `magnetostatic_inductance.rs`,
`transmon_eigen_sensitivity.rs`: central FD, relative agreement
`< 1e-4`). With a central difference the truncation error is
`O(h²) ≈ 1e-8` relative and the cancellation error `≈ ε_solve / h`, so
a step of `1e-4` sits well inside the window where both are far below
the tolerance.

tolerance.description:
Largest accepted relative disagreement `|g − g_FD| / max(|g|,
|g_FD|, 0.01·|value/p|)` per gradient entry (default `1e-4`; `>
0`). The floor (1 % of the entry's natural log-derivative scale)
only matters for structurally ~zero components.

n_forward_solves.description: Extra forward solves the check ran (`2` per parameter).

relative_step.description:
Relative central-difference step: parameter `p` re-solved at
`p·(1 ± relative_step)`.

FileRef.description: A file written by the CLI besides the report (additive in v1).

path.description:
For `--outdir` files: the path relative to the `--outdir`
directory (a bare file name). For `touchstone_file`: the
`--touchstone` argument as given on the command line (like
`spec_path`); likewise `spice_file` and `--spice`.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the bytes written.
Hex SHA-256 of the file bytes.

FrequencyResult.description:
One frequency point of a driven sweep.

For a **wave-port** spec there is no port impedance: `z_ohm` and
`ports` are empty, `y_s` is `null`, `s` is the power-normalized
channel S-matrix (port-major, mode-minor) and `wave_channels` carries
the per-channel `β` / `S_kk`.

far_field.description:
NTFF far-field quantities of this row (additive in v1; present
only with `--outdir` on a lumped-port spec with exactly one
`absorbing_regions` shell).

field_file.description:
Exported `E` field of this row (additive in v1; present only with
`--outdir` on a lumped-port spec).

iterations.description: Krylov iterations per RHS (one per port; `0` on the direct path).

materials.description:
Evaluated relative permittivity `ε_r(f)` of every dispersive
material, in spec order (additive in v1, issue #757; present only
when a material has a `dispersion` block).

residual_rel.description:
Worst post-solve relative residual over this point's RHS solves
(for an interpolated adaptive-sweep point: the reduced model's
residual indicator, worst over the port excitations).

roughness_k.description:
Roughness loss factor `K(f)` of every rough Leontovich wall, in
spec order (additive in v1, issue #758; present only when a wall
has a `roughness` block).

s.description: Scattering matrix vs the per-port reference resistances.

solved.description:
Adaptive sweep only (additive in v1, issue #708): `true` for a
full-order solve, `false` for a point interpolated by the
reduced-order model. Absent for a dense sweep (every point solved).

wave_channels.description:
Per-channel wave-port quantities (additive in v1; present only for
wave-port specs).

y_s.description: Admittance matrix `Y = Z⁻¹` (S); `null` if `Z` is singular.

FrequencySpec.description:
Frequency list: **either** an explicit `values` list **or** a
`start`/`stop`/`count` sweep, in the given `unit`.

count.description: Number of sweep points (`≥ 1`; `1` yields just `start`).

unit.description: Unit of every number in this block (required — no default).

k0.description: `k₀ = ω/c` (rad / mesh length unit) — the solver's ω.

oneOf.description:
Natural units: free-space wavenumber `k₀ = ω/c` in radians per
mesh length unit (the solver's internal `ω`).

length_unit_m.description: Metres per mesh length unit (from the layout).

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the mesh bytes.

path.description: Binary path or name as invoked.

n_elements.description: Tets (dim 3) or triangles (dim 2) in the group.

InductanceReport.description:
`geode inductance` report (`kind = "inductance"`, additive in v1,
issue #714).

The **static** Maxwell inductance matrix of open current paths
returning through a PEC wall, in henries (SI: the mesh length unit is
folded in), row-major `l_henry[row][col]` in path order. This is not
`geode extract`'s `l0_h` (an RF port's quasi-static `Im Z / ω`
extrapolated to `f → 0`).

current_a.description:
Net current each path was driven with (A): the Galerkin current
through its source face, `1` by normalisation.

flux_linkage_diag_henry.description:
Independent flux-linkage cross-check of the diagonal (H):
`Φ_i / I_i = A⁽ⁱ⁾ᵀ b⁽ⁱ⁾ / I_i²`, a different contraction than the
energy form (agrees to solver round-off).

git_sha.description: Git revision baked in at build time (`<sha>[-dirty]` or `unknown`).

inductance.description: The inductance settings and system size.

is_spd.description:
`true` iff the matrix is symmetric positive definite (Cholesky of
the symmetrised matrix). `false` flags a corrupted solve.

l_henry.description:
The N×N Maxwell inductance matrix (H): symmetric, positive
diagonal (self inductance), off-diagonals the mutual inductances.

max_rel_asymmetry.description:
`max |L_ij − L_ji| / max(|L_ij|, |L_ji|)`. Structural only: the
energy method fills `L_ji` from `L_ij`.

max_solenoidal_residual.description:
Largest discrete-divergence residual of any path's `J` (relative
to its RHS norm; round-off for the conduction construction).

mesh.description:
Mesh summary (`n_interior` counts the edges left after the PEC
wall and terminal contacts).

paths.description:
Path names in matrix row/column order (same order as
`inductance.paths`).

regions.description: Volume regions with applied `mu_r` (`eps_r` is unused here).

sensitivities.description:
`∂L_ij/∂ν_r` (or `∂L_ij/∂μ_r`) of every matrix entry (additive in
v1, issue #707; present only with a spec `sensitivity` section).

sink_current_a.description:
Galerkin current leaving through each path's sink (A): equals
`current_a` to round-off (discrete conservation certificate).

sink_face_flux_a.description:
Geometric face flux out of the conductor through each path's sink
triangles (A).

source_face_flux_a.description:
Geometric face flux `∫ J·n̂ dA` into the conductor through each
path's source triangles (A): an independent check of the 1 A
normalisation (exact for a uniform current, discretisation-order
close otherwise).

spec_path.description: Spec path as given on the command line.

spice_file.description:
The SPICE subcircuit `.subckt` (self inductors + `K` couplings)
written by `--spice` (additive in v1; present only with that flag).

threads.description: `--threads` value, or `null` when not given (library defaults).

InductanceSettingsSummary.description:
Echo of a resolved `inductance` section with the magnetostatic system
size (additive in v1, issue #714).

excitation.description:
Always `"open_path_conduction"`: per path, a P1 conduction solve
`∇·(σ∇φ) = 0` on the conductor (`φ = 1` source, `0` sink,
insulated elsewhere), `J = −σ∇φ` normalised to a 1 A Galerkin net
current.

gauge.description:
Always `"tree_cotree"` (the curl-curl gradient nullspace is
removed by eliminating a spanning forest's edges).

n_dof.description: Edge DOFs before PEC elimination (`= mesh.n_edges`).

n_free_dof.description:
Edge DOFs after eliminating the PEC wall and the terminal contacts
(before the gauge removes the tree edges).

n_solves.description: Magnetostatic solves (one sparse LU + solve per path).

paths.description: Current paths in matrix row/column order.

return_path.description:
Always `"pec_wall_return"`: the source / sink faces are PEC
contacts on the `boundary_conditions.pec` wall, which carries the
return current (`n×A = 0`).

inner.description: Always `"direct_lu"` (faer sparse LU on the gauged cotree block).

method.description:
Always `"energy"`: `L_ij = A⁽ⁱ⁾ᵀ K A⁽ʲ⁾ / (I_i I_j)` with the full
(pre-gauge) curl-curl.

solenoidal_tol.description:
Tolerance of the discrete-solenoidality gate each path's `J` passed
before its solve (relative to the RHS norm).

wall_time_s.description:
Wall time of the conduction solves, assembly, every magnetostatic
solve and post-processing, seconds.

InductanceSpec.description:
Static inductance-extraction settings (`geode inductance`, issue
#714).

For each current path, a P1 **conduction** solve on the path's
conductor volume (`∇·(σ∇φ) = 0`, `φ = 1` on `source`, `φ = 0` on
`sink`, insulated elsewhere) gives the current density `J = −σ∇φ`,
normalised to 1 A
([`geode_core::assembly::current_path::open_path_current`]). One
magnetostatic solve per path, `∇×(ν₀ν_r∇×A) = J` on lowest-order
Nédélec edges with a tree-cotree gauge and the `boundary_conditions.pec`
wall as `n×A = 0`, then gives the Maxwell inductance matrix by the
energy method `L_ij = A⁽ⁱ⁾ᵀ K A⁽ʲ⁾ / (I_i I_j)`
([`geode_core::assembly::magnetostatic3d::extract_inductance`]).

**Open paths, PEC return.** Each path's current enters through
`source` and leaves through `sink`; both faces are treated as PEC
contacts and must touch the `boundary_conditions.pec` wall, which is
the return conductor (e.g. a coax core whose end disks meet the shield
end caps). A closed loop with no terminals, or a terminal floating in
the dielectric, has no return path and is not supported in v1.

paths.description: Current paths in matrix row/column order (`≥ 1`, distinct names).

LeontovichSpec.description:
One Leontovich good-conductor surface
(`Z_s = (1 + j)·√(ωμ₀ / 2σ)`, times the roughness factor `K(f)` when
`roughness` is given).

physical_group.description: Name of a dimension-2 physical group.

roughness.description:
Conductor surface roughness (additive in v1, issue #758). Omit (or
`null`) for a smooth conductor. The whole complex `Z_s` is scaled
by the model's real loss factor `K(f) ≥ 1`, evaluated at the skin
depth `δ = 1/√(π f μ₀ σ)` of this wall's `conductivity_s_m`.

conductivity_natural.description: Conductivity in natural units `σ·η₀·L_unit` (1 / mesh length unit).

roughness.description:
Surface roughness (additive in v1, issue #758; present only for a
rough wall).

LumpedPortSpec.description: A uniform (Palace-style) lumped port on a surface physical group.

e_hat.description: Gap direction `ê` (normalized on load; must be non-zero).

length.description:
Gap length in mesh units (extent along `ê`). Omit to derive it
from the tagged faces' extent along `ê`.

physical_group.description: Name of a dimension-2 physical group holding the port faces.

resistance_ohm.description:
Port termination / reference resistance in ohms (`> 0`). This is
also the per-port S-parameter reference impedance `Z₀`.

v_inc.description:
Incident drive voltage `[re, im]` (default `[1, 0]`; must be
non-zero — every port is an S-parameter excitation).

width.description:
Port width in mesh units (extent across `ê`). Omit to derive it
from the tagged faces as `area / length`.

MaterialEpsResult.description:
The evaluated permittivity of one dispersive material at one
frequency (additive in v1, issue #757).

eps_r.description:
Relative permittivity `ε_r(f)` `[re, im]` (`im ≤ 0`) applied at
this row's frequency.

MaterialSpec.description:
Material of one volume physical group: complex permittivity and
(additive in v1, issue #714) real relative permeability.

dispersion.description:
Frequency-dependent permittivity model (additive in v1, issue
#757). Omit (or `null`) for a constant `eps_r`. When present,
`eps_r` must be left at its default: the region's permittivity at
each swept frequency is the model's `ε_r(f)` (`exp(+jωt)`,
`Im ε_r ≤ 0`). `driven` / `extract` dense sweeps only — rejected
with `sweep.adaptive`, `sensitivity` and by `eigen`,
`capacitance` and `inductance`.

eps_r.description:
Complex relative permittivity `[re, im]`, `im ≤ 0`
(`exp(+jωt)` convention: `ε_r = ε'(1 − j·tan δ)`). Defaults to
vacuum `[1, 0]` (so an inductance spec can list only `mu_r`).

mu_r.description:
Real relative permeability `μ_r` (finite, `> 0`; default `1`).
Honoured only by `geode inductance` in v1: every other analysis
rejects `μ_r ≠ 1` rather than silently ignoring it.

physical_group.description: Name of a dimension-3 physical group (`$PhysicalNames`).

MeshReport.description: `geode mesh` report (`kind = "mesh"`, additive in report schema v1).

analysis.description:
The `--analysis` the mesh and starter spec were built for
(`driven`, `capacitance` or `inductance`; additive, issue #720).

git_sha.description: Git revision baked in at build time (`<sha>[-dirty]` or `unknown`).

physical_groups.description: Generated physical groups, volumes then surfaces, in tag order.

spec_path.description: Spec path as given on the command line.

starter_spec_path.description: Where the starter spec was written (`--spec-out`), else `null`.

threads.description: `--threads` value, or `null` when not given (library defaults).

length_unit_m.description: Metres per mesh length unit (e.g. `1e-6` for a micron mesh).

path.description:
Path to a Gmsh MSH 4.1 ASCII tetrahedral mesh. Relative paths are
resolved against the directory containing the spec file.

n_edges.description: Nédélec edge-DOF count before PEC elimination.

n_interior.description: Edge DOFs kept after PEC elimination (the linear-system size).

path.description: Mesh path actually read (spec-relative paths resolved).

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the mesh file bytes.

field_file.description:
Exported mode field (additive in v1; present only with
`--outdir`): real (`E_real` only), `M_ε`-normalized and of
arbitrary sign for a lossless pencil; complex (`E_real` +
`E_imag`), bilinear `xᵀMx = 1`-normalized and of arbitrary complex
phase for a complex pencil.

k0_im.description:
Imaginary part of the complex resonant wavenumber `k₀ = √λ`
(principal branch, `Re k₀ ≥ 0`) — additive in v1, present only for a
complex pencil; `k0` is then `Re(k₀)`. `k0_im > 0` is a mode that
decays in time (`exp(+jωt)`: fields `∝ exp(−c·k0_im·t / L)`).

lambda_im.description:
Imaginary part of the complex eigenvalue `λ` (additive in v1,
issue #706; present only for a complex pencil — lossy `ε_r` and / or
`absorbing_regions`). `lambda` is then `Re(λ)`. Passive modes have
`lambda_im ≥ 0` (`exp(+jωt)` convention).

q.description:
Quality factor `Q = Re(k₀) / (2 |Im(k₀)|)`. `null` for a lossless
(real symmetric) pencil, where `Q` is undefined (infinite), not a
number; finite for a complex pencil (lossy `ε_r` and / or
`absorbing_regions`) — `null` there too for a mode with
`|Im(k₀)| ≤ 1e-12` (numerically lossless). The `1e-12` cutoff is
absolute in `k₀`'s rad / mesh length unit, not relative to
`Re(k₀)`. `Q` uses `|Im(k₀)|`, so a numerically spurious
**growing** mode (`k0_im < 0`) is not filtered out by `Q` alone —
check `k0_im`'s sign (see `geode_util::eigen::q_factor`).

PortExtraction.description: Per-port extraction results of a `geode extract` sweep.

im_z_zero_crossings_hz.description:
Every `Im Z_kk` sign change in the swept range (Hz), ascending,
linearly interpolated between samples. A sign change is a series
resonance or a flip through a pole (parallel anti-resonance).

l0_anchor_frequencies_hz.description: The two anchor frequencies used (Hz), ascending.

l0_check_frequency_hz.description: The third-lowest anchor `f₃` (Hz) behind the estimate.

l0_error_estimate_h.description:
Consistency estimate `|L₀(f₁,f₂) − L₀(f₂,f₃)|` (H) from the
third-lowest anchor; `null` with only two anchors.

l0_h.description:
Quasi-static inductance `L₀ = lim_{f→0} Im Z_kk / ω` (H), by
two-point Richardson extrapolation of `L(f) ≈ L₀ − a·f²` on the
two lowest anchors.

srf_hz.description:
Self-resonant frequency (Hz): the first entry of
`im_z_zero_crossings_hz`, `null` if the sweep brackets none.

PortResult.description:
Per-port self quantities at one frequency (from the diagonal `Z_kk`,
i.e. with every other port terminated in its own resistance).

l_h.description: Series inductance `Im Z_kk / ω` (H). Negative above self-resonance.

geometry_derived.description: `true` if width/length were derived from the tagged faces.

index.description: Port index (row/column in the Z/Y/S matrices).

oneOf.description: Incomplete LU with zero fill on `A(ω)`'s own sparsity pattern.

Hiptmair–Xu auxiliary-space Maxwell (AMS) V-cycle on a real SPD
proxy of `A(ω)` (issue #744): converges low-frequency, near-static
problems (e.g. spirals at 1 GHz) where `jacobi` / `ilu0` stall, at
an iteration count that stays flat with mesh size. Its nodal
(gradient-space) coarse problem is always solved by exact sparse LU
(`geode check` reports its modelled memory); see the CLI README for
measured memory.

absorbing_regions.description:
Matched (box) UPML absorbing shells on volume physical groups
(additive in v1, issue #683). Empty (default) = no UPML: the
driven operator uses the plain scalar per-tet `ε_r`. Driven /
extract / eigen specs; in an eigen spec (issue #706) the stretch is
evaluated once at `eigen.shift` (a linear open-cavity pencil, not
iterated to self-consistency with each mode's frequency).

boundary_conditions.description:
Boundary conditions on surface physical groups. Surfaces not named
here are natural (PMC-like) boundaries of the weak form.

capacitance.description:
Static capacitance-extraction settings (additive in v1, issue
#705). Its presence makes this a **capacitance spec** (for `geode
capacitance`).

eigen.description:
Eigenmode analysis settings. Its presence makes this an **eigen
spec** (for `geode eigen`).

extract.description:
Inductance-extraction settings. Its presence makes this an
**extract spec** (for `geode extract`). Without `eigen` or
`extract` the spec is a driven spec.

frequencies.description:
Frequencies to solve at. Required for a `driven` / `extract` spec;
not allowed in an `eigen` spec (its target is [`EigenSpec::shift`]).

inductance.description:
Static inductance-extraction settings (additive in v1, issue
#714). Its presence makes this an **inductance spec** (for `geode
inductance`).

materials.description:
Per-volume-region complex relative permittivity. Volume physical
groups not listed here default to vacuum (`ε_r = 1`); the `check`
report lists which regions defaulted.

ports.description:
Lumped ports. A `driven` / `extract` spec needs at least one lumped
port **or** (driven only) at least one wave port; an `eigen` spec
must have none (lumped ports are driven resistive terminations; the
eigen solve computes source-free resonances).

sensitivity.description:
Material design sensitivities of the analysis's observable
(additive in v1, issues #707 / #739). Not an analysis section: it
rides on a `capacitance` (two-terminal), `inductance`, lossless
`eigen` or one-lumped-port `driven` spec and adds a `sensitivities`
block to that report. Extract specs reject it in v1.

sweep.description:
Frequency-sweep strategy (additive in v1, issue #708). Omitted: the
dense sweep — one full-order solve per frequency. Driven / extract
specs only.

wave_ports.description:
Wave (modal) ports on planar surface physical groups (additive in
v1, issue #683). `driven` specs only, and in v1 mutually exclusive
with lumped `ports` and with Leontovich / Silver-Müller walls.

dispersion.description:
The region's dispersion model (additive in v1, issue #757; present
only for a dispersive region).

eps_r_source.description:
`"spec"`, `"default_vacuum"` or (issue #757) `"dispersion"` — for
which `eps_r` is the model at its reference frequency `f_ref_hz`.

mu_r.description:
Applied real relative permeability (additive in v1, issue #714;
`1` unless an inductance spec lists `mu_r` for the region).

ResourceEstimate.description:
`geode check`'s up-front resource estimate (additive in v1).

**Order-of-magnitude only.** The direct-LU figures are a linear-in-
`nnz(A)` extrapolation from a single measured anchor (2026-07-15,
1.16M-DOF transmon eigen run; `calibration_basis` names it). LU fill
grows super-linearly, so the estimate is biased high on meshes much
smaller than the anchor and low on larger ones. Symbolic-fill
predictors are deliberately not used: at the anchor scale an ordering
that won on symbolic fill was OOM-killed by the real LU.

above_anchor.description:
`anchor_nnz_ratio > 1`: the mesh is larger than the calibration
anchor, where super-linear LU fill makes the direct estimates
**under**-estimates (`conservative_below_anchor` no longer holds).

anchor_nnz_ratio.description:
`nnz_a` divided by the direct-LU calibration anchor's `nnz(A)`
(`check::ANCHOR_NNZ`). Always taken against the **direct** anchor,
even for `solver_mode = "iterative"` (which has no measured
anchor): a scale signal, not a confidence claim.

calibration_basis.description: The calibration anchor, its date and the scaling assumptions.

flops_max.description:
Worst-case total flops at `max_iters` for every RHS and
frequency, iterative only.

flops_per_iteration.description:
Floating-point operations per Krylov iteration (one complex SpMV
plus vector updates), iterative only.

n_factorizations.description:
LU factorizations the run performs (one per frequency for
driven / extract direct, one for eigen, one per current path for
inductance, `0` iterative).

n_rhs_per_frequency.description:
Right-hand sides per frequency (ports, or `2 × channels` for wave
ports; `0` for eigen; `1` per factorization for inductance).

nnz_a.description:
Non-zeros of the full Nédélec system pattern before PEC
elimination (the anchor's convention).

scalar.description:
`"real"` (lossless eigen pencil, magnetostatic inductance system)
or `"complex"` (driven / extract, lossy / open eigen pencil).

solver_mode.description:
`"direct"` or `"iterative"` (an eigen or inductance spec is always
`"direct"`).

wall_time_confidence.description:
Accuracy class of the direct wall-time figures:
`"conservative_below_anchor"` — machine-dependent, and on every
in-repo fixture measured (all far below the anchor) 4–40× **high**;
above the anchor, super-linear fill makes it an under-estimate.
`null` for iterative (no wall-time figure).

wall_time_per_factorization_s.description:
Per-factorization wall-time **scaling unit** (s), direct only:
the anchor run's *total* wall time (assembly + one real LU
factorization + the shift-invert Lanczos back-solves;
`check::ANCHOR_WALL_S`) scaled by `nnz(A)` and the complex-pencil
time factor. `wall_time_s` is this times `n_factorizations`. It is
**not** a measurement of one isolated factorization: despite the
name it includes the anchor's assembly and back-solve time.

wall_time_s.description:
Estimated total wall time (s), direct only (`null` iterative: no
measured anchor).

RoughnessKResult.description:
The roughness loss factor of one rough Leontovich wall at one
frequency (additive in v1, issue #758).

k.description: Loss factor `K(f) ≥ 1` multiplying the wall's smooth `Z_s`.

RoughnessSpec.description:
Conductor surface-roughness model of a Leontovich wall (issue #758),
selected by `model`.

rms_m.description:
RMS surface roughness `Δ` in metres (finite, `≥ 0`; `0` is
exactly the smooth conductor).

oneOf.description:
Huray snowball model, single sphere size on a flat base
(cannonball form): `K = 1 + (3/2)·(N·4πa²/A_tile) / (1 + δ/a +
δ²/(2a²))`, saturating at `1 + (3/2)·N·4πa²/A_tile`.

n_balls.description:
Spheres `N` per tile (finite, `≥ 0`; may be fractional; `0` is
the smooth conductor).

tile_area_m2.description:
Tile (flat base) area `A_tile` in square metres (finite,
`> 0`).

RoughnessSummary.description:
Conductor surface roughness of a Leontovich wall (additive in v1,
issue #758): the model as given plus its loss factor `K(f)` at every
requested frequency. The wall's `Z_s` is the smooth
`(1 + j)·√(ωμ₀/2σ)` times `K(f)`.

k.description:
Loss factor `K(f) ≥ 1` at each entry of the report's `frequencies`,
in the same order.

n_balls.description: Huray spheres per tile `N`; absent for `hammerstad`.

fd_rel_error.description:
`|gradient − fd_gradient| / max(|gradient|, |fd_gradient|, 0.01 ·
|value / p|)` with `p` the parameter value — relative, with a floor
at 1 % of the component's natural (log-derivative) scale so a
structurally ~zero component is not judged against
central-difference round-off (present only with `fd_check`).

index.description:
Observable component: `[]` for the scalar capacitance, `[i, j]`
(path indices) for `l_henry[i][j]`, `[mode]` (index into the
report's `modes`) for `frequency_hz`, `[i]` (index into the
report's `results`) for `s11_mag_sq`.

SensitivityParameterKind.description: Material property differentiated by a sensitivity parameter.

oneOf.description: Real relative permittivity `Re ε_r` (capacitance, eigen, driven).

Relative reluctivity `ν_r = 1/μ_r` (inductance) — the parameter
the inductance energy form is linear in.

physical_group.description:
Name of a dimension-3 physical group (need not be listed in
`materials`: an unlisted group is differentiated at its vacuum
default).

value.description: Parameter value at which the gradient was taken (dimensionless).

SensitivityReport.description:
Material design sensitivities of a report's observable (additive in
v1, issues #707 / #739).

Every gradient is exact for the **discrete** model (adjoint /
Hellmann–Feynman, no finite differencing) and is in observable units
per unit parameter: the parameters (`eps_r`, `nu_r`, `mu_r`) are
dimensionless, so `gradient` has the unit of `value`
(`observable_unit`).

entries.description:
One entry per (parameter, observable component): capacitance one
per parameter, inductance `N × N` per parameter (row-major `i`,
`j`), eigen one per `sensitivity.modes` entry per parameter, driven
one per swept frequency per parameter.

fd_check.description:
The finite-difference self-check (present only with
`sensitivity.fd_check`). A run whose check fails is a
`solve_failed` error, so a present block always passed.

method.description:
How the gradient was computed: `"adjoint_p2"` (capacitance: one
forward + one adjoint solve on a shared factorization),
`"self_adjoint_energy"` (inductance: a local contraction of the
forward solutions, no extra solve) or `"hellmann_feynman"` (eigen:
`∂λ/∂ε_k = −λ·xᵀM_k x` on the converged simple eigenpair, chained
through `f = c√λ / (2π L)`) or `"adjoint_port_loaded"` (driven:
one forward + one adjoint solve per frequency on one LU of the
lumped-port-loaded operator).

observable.description:
The differentiated observable: `"c_farad_p2"` (two-terminal P2
capacitance — distinct from, and about the P1 discretization
error off, the report's own `c_farad`), `"l_henry"`
(inductance-matrix entries), `"frequency_hz"` (eigenmode
resonant frequency) or `"s11_mag_sq"` (driven: the squared
reflection magnitude `|S11|²` of the single lumped port).

observable_unit.description:
Unit of every entry's `value` and `gradient`: `"F"`, `"H"`, `"Hz"`
or `"1"` (dimensionless `|S11|²`).

parameters.description:
The design parameters, in spec order (`entries[*].parameter`
indexes this list).

wall_time_s.description: Wall time of the gradient (and FD check) computation, seconds.

SensitivitySpec.description:
Material design sensitivities (additive in v1, issue #707): exact
discrete gradients of the analysis's observable with respect to
per-region material parameters, from the library's FD-validated
adjoint / Hellmann–Feynman machinery (Epic #569).

| analysis | observable | parameter kinds | method |
|---|---|---|---|
| `capacitance` (exactly one terminal) | two-terminal `C` (F) at **P2** | `eps_r` | discrete adjoint |
| `inductance` | every `L_ij` (H) | `nu_r`, `mu_r` | self-adjoint energy form |
| `eigen` (lossless) | `frequency_hz` of the listed `modes` | `eps_r` | Hellmann–Feynman |
| `driven` (one lumped port, direct, dense, no UPML) | squared reflection `s11_mag_sq` per frequency | `eps_r` | port-loaded discrete adjoint |

Not supported in v1 (rejected with `invalid_spec`): extract specs
(`Z`, `L₀`, `Q`), multi-port / wave-port / UPML / adaptive / iterative
driven specs, N-terminal capacitance matrices, lossy / open eigen specs
(`Q`), loss-tangent (`Im ε_r`) and shape / geometry parameters.

fd_check.description:
Optional central finite-difference self-check: every parameter is
re-solved at `p·(1 ± relative_step)` and each gradient entry is
compared to the FD estimate. A disagreement above `tolerance`
fails the run with `solve_failed`. Costs two extra forward solves
per parameter.

min_rel_gap.description:
Eigen specs only: minimum relative gap `|λ − λ_j| / λ` to every
other returned mode for a differentiated mode to count as simple
(default `1e-2`, the library's FD-validated value). A (near-)
degenerate mode fails the run with `solve_failed`: Hellmann–Feynman
does not apply to it.

modes.description:
Eigen specs only: indices (into the report's ascending `modes`) of
the modes to differentiate (default `[0]`). Each must be `<
eigen.n_modes`, and the spec needs `eigen.n_modes ≥ 2` so the
simple-eigenvalue gap check has a neighbour to measure.

parameters.description:
Design parameters, one per (volume physical group, kind) pair
(`≥ 1`, distinct). The gradient is taken at the spec's material
values; every tet of the group shares the parameter.

oneOf.description:
Sparse direct LU, one factorization per frequency (default). A
struct variant so `deny_unknown_fields` rejects stray keys such as
`tol` under `mode = "direct"`.

COCG Krylov iteration with a preconditioner (Jacobi by default)
built once per frequency. Non-convergence within `max_iters` is a
hard error.

SolverStats.description: Aggregate solver statistics for a driven sweep.

adaptive.description:
Adaptive-sweep diagnostics (additive in v1, issue #708). Present
only for a spec with `sweep.adaptive`.

iterations_max.description: Largest per-RHS Krylov iteration count over the sweep (`0` direct).

jobs.description:
Concurrent frequency workers (`--jobs`; additive in v1, issue
#708). Present only when `--jobs` was given.

residual_rel_max.description: Largest post-solve relative residual `‖Ax − b‖/‖b‖` over the sweep.

wall_time_s.description: Wall time of the whole sweep (assembly + all solves), seconds.

SweepSpec.description:
Frequency-sweep strategy of a driven / extract spec (additive in v1,
issue #708).

adaptive.description: Opt-in adaptive sweep. Omitted: the dense sweep.

UpmlSpec.description:
A matched (full Sacks) box-UPML absorbing shell on one volume physical
group.

The shell's **inner wall** (the air box) is derived from the mesh: the
bounding box of every mesh node, shrunk inward by `thickness` on every
face. Each tet of the group whose centroid lies outside that box gets
the complex coordinate stretch `s_i = 1 − j·sigma_0·(d_i/thickness)²/k₀`
per axis (`d_i` = depth beyond the inner wall on axis `i`), applied as
the constitutive tensors `ε = ε_r·Λ`, `ν = Λ⁻¹` on top of the group's
`materials` permittivity (vacuum if unlisted). The mesh must therefore
be an **axis-aligned box** whose outer shell of depth `thickness` is
the absorbing region; terminate it with a PEC outer wall.

physical_group.description: Name of a dimension-3 physical group (the absorbing shell tets).

sigma_0.description:
UPML strength `σ₀` of the quadratic profile, in **natural units**
(rad per mesh length unit — the same unit as `k₀`), `> 0`. `25` is
the repo's validated value for the patch-antenna / Mie shells.

thickness.description:
Shell thickness in mesh units (`> 0`, less than half the mesh
extent on every axis).

air_box_hi.description: Derived inner wall (air box) high corner (mesh units).

air_box_lo.description: Derived inner wall (air box) low corner (mesh units).

n_tets_stretched.description: Tets beyond the inner wall (the ones actually stretched).

sigma_0.description: UPML strength σ₀ (natural units, rad / mesh length unit).

WaveChannelResult.description: Per-channel quantities of a wave-port sweep at one frequency.

beta.description:
Propagation constant `β` (rad / mesh length unit): real positive
when propagating, `−j|β|` when evanescent.

WaveModeSummary.description: One solved cross-section mode of a wave port.

mode.description: Mode index within the port (ascending cutoff).

WavePortSpec.description:
A wave (modal) port on a planar surface physical group.

The tagged faces are projected into a local 2-D cross-section whose
rim (edges on a single face triangle) is PEC; the `n_modes`
lowest-cutoff transverse modes of that cross-section become the port's
S-parameter channels (TEM modes of multiply connected cross-sections
are not supported).

a_inc.description:
Per-mode incident amplitude `[re, im]`, length `n_modes`, every
entry finite and non-zero. Default: `[1, 0]` for every mode.

physical_group.description:
Name of a dimension-2 physical group holding the (planar) port
faces.

modes.description: Solved modes (`driven` reports); `null` in `check` (no modal solve).

n_interior_port_edges.description:
Cross-section interior edges (the modal problem size; rim edges
are PEC).

description: Output of every `geode` subcommand except `schema`: exactly one JSON document, one of eight kinds discriminated by the top-level `kind` (`check`, `driven`, `eigen`, `extract`, `capacitance`, `inductance`, `mesh`, `error`). Each branch pins `kind` and `status` with `const`, so exactly one branch matches. Report objects are open (no `additionalProperties: false`): fields added within report schema v1 are additive, and consumers should ignore fields they do not know.
title: GEODE report (schema v1)
